title: ci: take template updates (safe bucket, workflows)
body:
## Summary
`upgrade.ps1 -Apply` against repo-template `ec47f2d` — the *safe* bucket, protected half (four workflows this repo never customised):

| File | What moved |
|---|---|
| `actions-audit.yaml` | actionlint 1.7.7 → 1.7.12; zizmor SARIF upload only where the token can write |
| `license-audit.yaml` | policy JSON taken from `main` (incl. new `package-overrides.json`); `nuget-license` via `dotnet tool restore` |
| `sbom.yaml` | cyclonedx via `dotnet tool restore`; workload restore |
| `security-alerts.yml` | template's current triage + autofix jobs |

Configuration-only → passes the guard; bypass merge. Stacked on #608 (which is on #609, which carries the `.config/dotnet-tools.json` these need).
